title: Possessory – Home Inventory & Warranty Tracker
short_description: Keep belongings, receipts and warranty details beautifully organised on your device.
description: Give everything you own a place. Organise household belongings by room with photos, receipts, purchase details and warranty dates. Search your records, track warranties and save ZIP backups on your device. Core inventory works offline and no account is required. Free includes one household, up to 30 belongings and three attachments per belonging. An optional one-time Premium purchase adds unlimited belongings and households, receipt OCR, advanced reminders, maintenance, PDF/CSV/JSON exports, saved searches, expanded voice commands and password-protected backups. Premium has no subscription; Amazon displays your local price. Purchase verification requires internet, with signed offline access for up to 90 days before refresh. Speech recognition depends on your device provider and may use a network service. Review receipt suggestions before applying them. Inventory reports are user-maintained records, not insurer-certified valuations.
